milestone.title: Complete the behavior-preserving PSOD module split

acceptance.text: Extract stateful missing-value handling without changing fitted-imputer behavior
Extract numeric transformation and feature-filtering concerns from the estimator facade
Isolate per-feature model fitting and prediction-error calculation behind internal boundaries
Reduce remaining core coupling in persistence and explanation utilities while preserving the public estimator facade and characterization tests

outcomes.target: Behavior-preserving modular PSOD baseline ready for leakage-controlled scoring redesign
